ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can register baggage and dispatch robots automatically, but people are still needed to notice whether a guest is tired and arrange their bags in a reassuring way.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 32,500 baggage porters and bellhops were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 32,000 by 2034, a net decrease of about 500 jobs, with approximately 4,600 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $36,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace baggage porters and bellhops. Moving luggage is physical work, and robots suit only fixed routes. Concierge service depends on adaptability and human warmth; a guest asking for help booking a hard-to-reserve restaurant still needs a person. AI is most useful for back-office tasks such as storage registration and room-status lookup.
ai_s2_accel: Robotic baggage transport on fixed routes
Self-service lockers with QR-code storage and retrieval
Smart key cards and self-guided room directions
Voice assistants handling common questions
ai_s2_auto: Digital baggage storage registration
Self-service room-status and ride information lookup
Automatic recording of guest profiles and preferences
Digital concierge forms and shift handoffs
ai_s3_list: On-site adaptability: provide solutions quickly when unexpected situations arise.
Human communication: understand guest emotions and unspoken needs.
Strength and coordination: move heavy items and work with a team.
Local knowledge: practical experience with routes, food, and events.
Service judgment: be warm without crossing boundaries and attentive without intruding.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10, low, means baggage porters and bellhops have limited AI exposure. Their core actions involve carrying, moving, guiding, and answering in physical spaces, requiring bodies and on-site judgment. AI can assist only with peripheral tasks such as registration and lookup.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not allow complacency. Self-service lockers and robotic luggage carts are already being piloted at luxury hotels, reducing the share of pure carrying work. Bellhops who converse well, recommend itineraries, and build a personal concierge reputation become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This career does not require extensive education, but decide whether it is a temporary job or a long-term path. For a career, aim toward concierge supervisor or front-office management and learn English and hotel systems. For short-term income, peak-season work can help, but plan early for slower periods.

Build a recognizable concierge service: remember frequent guests' preferences, plan local itineraries, and use positive review rates on your resume. Learn hotel digital systems and how to troubleshoot self-service equipment to become more competitive than someone who only carries bags.

People with no experience can start as concierge attendants or bellhops. Develop two essentials: physical stamina and conversational skill. Confidence that you can carry, connect, and remember goes a long way in interviews. Strong language skills support applications to international hotel chains.

Bellhop retention is difficult because earnings vary between peak and slow seasons. Combine guaranteed base pay, transparent tips, and rotating peak-season leave. Give high performers access to front-office training so entry-level roles become a talent pipeline.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Room status and guest information management
QR-code storage and retrieval with shorter queues

ai_s7_trends: Luxury hotels and destination resorts are upgrading concierge experiences, increasing demand for personalized service.
Self-service equipment and robots are entering fixed settings, slowly reducing pure carrying roles.
Bilingual, locally knowledgeable bellhops who build strong reputations are more sought after.

body: Baggage porters and bellhops move, store, deliver, and retrieve guest baggage at hotels, resorts, and similar properties. They escort guests to rooms, provide valet and concierge assistance, answer questions, and run everyday errands as frontline guest-service employees.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can register baggage and dispatch robots automatically, but people are still needed to notice whether a guest is tired and arrange their bags in a reassuring way.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动登记行李、调度机器人，但「客人是不是累了、箱子怎么放他更安心」这种现场眼力，还得靠活人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年行李搬运员行李员在岗约 3.25 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.20 万人，岗位净减约 0.05 万个，年均产生约 0.46 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.60 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代行李员：搬运行李是纯体力活，机器人只适合固定线路；而礼宾服务拼的是现场应变和人情味，客人一句「能不能帮我订个不好订的餐厅」，就是 AI 暂时接不住的活。AI 能帮的是寄存登记、房态查询这类后台事务。
ai_s2_accel: 机器人行李搬运覆盖固定线路
自助寄存柜与扫码存取
智能门卡与房间引导自助化
语音助手承担常见问询
ai_s2_auto: 行李寄存登记电子化
房态与叫车信息自助查询
客人档案与偏好自动记录
礼宾表单与交接班流程数字化
ai_s3_list: 现场应变：突发状况下快速给出方案。
人情沟通：读得懂客人情绪和潜台词。
体力与协调：搬运重物与多人协作。
本地信息力：路线、美食、活动的实战经验。
服务分寸：热情而不越界，周到而不打扰。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明行李员是「低 AI 曝光」的服务岗位：核心动作是搬、跑、带、答，都发生在真实空间里，需要身体和现场判断，AI 只能在登记、查询这些外围事务上帮忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不代表能躺平：自助寄存柜、机器人行李车已经在五星酒店试点，纯搬运的份额会被挤占。会跟客人聊天、能提供行程建议、把礼宾服务做出个人品牌的行李员，反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 做这行不用高学历，但要想清楚是「过渡」还是「长期」：想长期发展就奔着礼宾主管、前厅管理去，顺便把英语和酒店系统学起来；纯为挣快钱的话，旺季做做可以，淡季要早做打算。
把礼宾服务做出招牌：记熟常客偏好、会规划本地行程、把好评率做成简历。同时留意酒店数字化系统，会用自助设备排障，比纯搬运有竞争力。
零经验可从礼宾员或行李员入职，重点练两项：体力和嘴皮子。面试时能拿出「搬得动、聊得来、记得住」的自信，基本就稳了；语言好的可以往国际连锁酒店投。
行李员难留人，核心是淡旺季收入落差。建议「底薪保底 + 小费透明 + 旺季轮休」三件套，给优秀员工开前厅培训通道，把一线岗位做成人才培养池。

ai_s7_trends: 高端酒店与度假综合体升级礼宾体验，个性化服务需求上升。
自助设备与机器人进入固定场景，纯搬运岗位缓慢收缩。
会双语、懂本地、能经营口碑的礼宾型行李员更抢手。

body: 行李搬运员与行李员在酒店、度假村等场所负责客人的行李搬运、寄存与送取，提供带房、泊车、礼宾问询与日常跑腿服务，是酒店对客服务的一线岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动登记行李、调度机器人，但「客人是不是累了、箱子怎么放他更安心」这种现场眼力，还得靠活人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate a full year of carbon emissions, but the CSO still uses business judgment to set the target, prioritize investments, and persuade the board.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 309,400 Chief Sustainability Officers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 322,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 13,300 jobs, with about 22,200 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $206,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Chief Sustainability Officers, but it will take over the data layer. Carbon accounting, data collection, ESG report drafts, and compliance monitoring can be automated. CSOs create value through strategy, target tradeoffs, cross-functional execution, and stakeholder communication. AI supplies evidence for work centered on persuasion and change.
ai_s2_accel: AI models that forecast emissions-reduction pathways and costs
Carbon footprint tracking across the supply chain
ESG data platforms that standardize disclosures
AI-assisted green supplier ratings
ai_s2_auto: Automated carbon accounting and data collection
ESG report drafts and data organization
Compliance monitoring and policy tracking
Automated supply-chain carbon data aggregation
ai_s3_list: Strategic judgment: balance emissions targets with business returns.
Cross-functional execution: mobilize production, procurement, and finance.
Stakeholder communication: balance boards, investors, regulators, and the public.
Target management: convert broad goals into measurable KPI targets.
Change leadership: explain sustainability in business terms.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. AI is reshaping the data and documentation layer through faster carbon accounting, reporting, and compliance monitoring. Entry-level ESG roles contract, while executive value remains in strategy and execution. Greater data transparency makes decisive CSOs more scarce.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure reflects a function becoming standard. Dual-carbon regulation pushes large companies to appoint sustainability leaders, creating a hiring tailwind. CSOs who combine AI data tools with business and strategy skills can move from an emerging role toward a standard board-level position.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Sustainability offers a durable direction. Consider environmental science, energy, business, or economics for undergraduate study, then add management and finance at graduate level. Strong candidates combine environmental goals with commercial analysis; passion alone does not sustain this career.

Master carbon management credentials and ESG frameworks, then strengthen cross-functional execution and executive communication. Advancement from ESG manager to sustainability director depends on leading complete programs. Use AI data tools for efficiency and reserve time for strategy.

Audit, consulting, supply-chain, and environmental engineering backgrounds transfer well. Learn carbon accounting and ESG standards, earn relevant credentials, and enter through sustainability manager or ESG roles. In interviews, quantify the projects, emissions reductions, and cost savings you delivered.

Do not hire only an environmental expert as CSO. Choose a versatile leader who speaks in the boardroom and drives execution across business units. Equip the sustainability team with AI accounting tools so people can focus on strategy and project delivery.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Pathway and cost estimates for emissions reduction

ai_s7_trends: Dual-carbon goals and ESG regulation push companies to establish sustainability functions, expanding CSO roles.
AI takes over carbon accounting and disclosure, shifting CSOs toward strategy and cross-functional execution.
Combined business + sustainability + governance expertise becomes a core executive requirement.

body: Chief Sustainability Officers set and execute corporate sustainability strategy. They coordinate carbon reduction, environmental compliance, social responsibility, and ESG governance across business units and stakeholders, turning sustainability goals into operating action.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate a full year of carbon emissions, but the CSO still uses business judgment to set the target, prioritize investments, and persuade the board.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动算完整年的碳排数据，但「碳目标定多高、先投哪个项目、怎么说服董事会」——这个决定，得 CSO 用商业智慧来扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年首席可持续发展官在岗约 30.94 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 32.27 万人，净增约 1.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 20.64 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代首席可持续发展官，但会接管数据层：碳核算、数据收集、ESG 报告初稿、合规监控都能自动化。CSO 的价值集中在战略制定、目标取舍、跨部门推动和利益相关方沟通——这是「说服与推动」的工作，AI 只能提供弹药。
ai_s2_accel: AI 模型预测减排路径与成本
碳足迹追踪贯穿供应链
ESG 数据平台统一披露口径
AI 辅助供应商绿色评级
ai_s2_auto: 碳排放核算与数据收集自动化
ESG 报告初稿与数据整理
合规监控与政策动态追踪
供应链碳数据自动汇总
ai_s3_list: 战略判断：在减排目标与商业回报之间定方向。
跨部门推动：让生产、采购、财务都动起来。
利益相关方沟通：董事会、投资者、监管、公众多方平衡。
目标管理：把宏大目标拆成可考核的 KPI。
变革领导：用商业语言讲好可持续发展的故事。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明 CSO 岗位的「数据与文书层」正被 AI 重构：碳核算、报告、合规监控都大幅提效，基础 ESG 岗位会收缩。但高管岗位的价值在战略与推动——AI 让数据更透明，也让「能决策、能推动」的 CSO 更稀缺。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着职能正在普及：双碳监管推动每个大企业都要有可持续发展负责人，这是岗位红利。把 AI 数据工具用好，同时强化商业与战略能力，CSO 会从「新兴职位」变成「董事会标配」。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 可持续发展是确定性强的方向，建议本科读环境/能源/经管，硕士叠加管理与金融。孩子要有「既能讲环保、又能算商业账」的复合志向，纯情怀在这个领域走不远。
把碳管理认证和 ESG 框架学透，同时强化跨部门推动与高管沟通能力。从 ESG 经理往可持续发展总监升级，关键在「有没有推动过成体系的项目」。用 AI 数据工具提升效率，把时间留给战略。
有审计、咨询、供应链、环境工程背景的人转型有优势。先补碳核算和 ESG 标准，考取相关认证，从可持续发展经理或 ESG 岗切入；面试时讲清楚「你推动过什么、省了多少碳、省了多少钱」。
招 CSO 别只找「环保专家」，要找「能进董事会说话、能推动业务线执行」的复合管理者。给可持续发展团队配 AI 核算工具，把人力投入到战略和项目推动上，目标才落得了地。

ai_s7_trends: 双碳与 ESG 监管推动企业普遍设立可持续发展职能，CSO 岗位扩容。
AI 接管碳核算与披露，CSO 重心转向战略与跨部门推动。
「商业 + 可持续 + 治理」复合能力成为高管人才的核心门槛。

body: 首席可持续发展官负责制定并推动企业可持续发展战略，统筹碳减排、环境合规、社会责任与 ESG 治理，协调各业务线与利益相关方，把可持续发展目标转化为企业的实际。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动算完整年的碳排数据，但「碳目标定多高、先投哪个项目、怎么说服董事会」——这个决定，得 CSO 用商业智慧来扛。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can organize case records perfectly, but only the social worker sitting across from a silent child can see whether hope remains in their eyes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 399,900 Child, Family, And School Social Workers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 413,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 13,400 jobs, with about 35,100 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $58,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Child, Family, And School Social Workers, but it will reduce deskwork. AI can handle case records, risk assessments, and resource lists, returning time to children and families. Face-to-face trust, crisis judgment, and cross-agency action remain irreplaceably human.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted identification of high-risk cases
Cross-agency data integration for decisions
Online parent education and psychological assessment tools
Intelligent reminders for case milestones
ai_s2_auto: Template-based case record organization
Automated forms and assessment report generation
Database-driven resource lists and referral information
Digital files and progress tracking
ai_s3_list: Face-to-face trust: long-term sincerity helps children and families speak openly.
Crisis intervention judgment: deciding when and how to intervene carries major responsibility.
Multi-party coordination: social workers connect schools, civil affairs, courts, and health services.
Ethics and boundaries: AI cannot resolve confidentiality, mandatory reporting, and conflicts of interest.
Emotional resilience: remain professional and hopeful through sustained exposure to trauma.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate AI exposure range. Most work happens directly with people. AI accelerates the standardized documentation and recordkeeping tasks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. As AI takes over paperwork, social workers can focus more on cases. Administrative workers who only produce documents face pressure, while professionals who intervene effectively and accept responsibility become scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study social work or psychology, complete substantial field placements, and earn a social work credential early. Learn data and assessment skills for the AI era, while developing communication and crisis intervention as core capabilities.

Use AI documentation and risk assessment tools to return time to cases. Advance toward supervision, program leadership, or specialties such as child protection and school social work. Professional depth creates negotiating power.

Earn a social work credential and start as a school social work assistant or frontline agency worker. Prepare a clear story about the hardest case you handled; it carries more weight than general statements about compassion.

Assess ethics + crisis response when hiring social workers. Present a mandatory reporting scenario and ask for the candidate's approach. Credentialed, emotionally stable workers who manage documentation deserve stronger supervision and pay.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Draft case notes and assessment reports
Milestone reminders and case closure tracking

ai_s7_trends: Stronger child protection and mental health policy increases demand for professional social workers.
Case management becomes fully digital, with AI documentation and risk assessment becoming standard.
Social work shifts from administration toward professional supervision, increasing demand for people who intervene and accept responsibility.

body: Child, Family, And School Social Workers provide case management, family support, crisis intervention, and resource referrals for children, adolescents, and their families. They coordinate schools, communities, and public agencies to protect children's safety, development, and rights.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can organize case records perfectly, but only the social worker sitting across from a silent child can see whether hope remains in their eyes.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把个案记录整理得整整齐齐，但家访时那个沉默的孩子眼里有没有光，只有坐他对面的社工知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年儿童、家庭与学校社会工作者在岗约 39.99 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 41.33 万人，净增约 1.34 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.51 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.86 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代儿童家庭学校社工，但会减掉案头负担。个案记录、风险评估、资源清单都能让 AI 代劳，社工把时间还给孩子和家庭。真正无法替代的，是面对面的信任、危机时刻的判断和跨部门推动事情的能力。
ai_s2_accel: AI 风险评估辅助识别高风险个案
多部门数据联动辅助决策
在线家长课堂与心理测评工具
智能提醒跟进个案节点
ai_s2_auto: 个案记录的模板化整理
文书表格与评估报告的自动生成
资源清单与转介信息的数据库化
档案与进度追踪的电子化
ai_s3_list: 面对面建立信任：让孩子和家庭愿意开口，靠的是长期的真诚。
危机干预判断：什么时候必须介入、怎么介入，责任重大。
多方协调推动：学校、民政、司法、医疗，社工是穿针引线的人。
伦理判断与边界：保密、强制报告、利益冲突，AI 给不了答案。
情感韧性：长期面对创伤仍能保持专业与希望。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分时间在与人打交道的现场，能被标准化的环节是文书和记录，这些正在被 AI 加速。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：文书被 AI 接管后，社工的时间更聚焦于个案本身。被挤压的是只会写材料、不深入现场的行政化社工，会做干预、能担责任的专业社工反而更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读社会工作、心理学专业，大学期间多做实务实习，尽早考社工证。AI 时代要会看数据、做评估，把沟通和危机干预练成真本事。
把 AI 文书和风险评估工具用起来，把时间还给个案。往督导、项目主管、专门领域（儿童保护、学校社工）发展，专业深度才有议价力。
考社工证，从学校社工助理或机构一线做起。面试准备一个「你处理过最难的个案」的故事，比空谈爱心更有说服力。
招社工要考「伦理判断 + 危机应对」：给一个强制报告场景问怎么办。持证、能扛文书、情绪稳定的社工，值得给更好的督导支持和薪酬。

ai_s7_trends: 未成年人保护与心理健康政策加码，专业化社工需求上升。
个案管理全面数字化，AI 文书与风险评估成为标配。
社工从行政化走向专业督导化，会干预、能担责的复合人才更吃香。

body: 儿童、家庭与学校社工面向儿童青少年及其家庭提供个案管理、家庭支持、危机干预与资源链接，协调学校、社区与相关部门，保障儿童的成长安全与权益。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把个案记录整理得整整齐齐，但家访时那个沉默的孩子眼里有没有光，只有坐他对面的社工知道。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can produce a damage estimate in minutes and search past claims instantly, but people still judge responsibility and negotiate the outcome.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 356,100 Claims Adjusters, Examiners, And Investigators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 337,900 by 2034, a net decrease of about 18,200 jobs, with about 21,100 annual job openings. The median annual salary is about $76,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will reshape claims work without eliminating it. Image-based damage assessment, automated review, and fraud models already process many simple auto claims and reduce demand for routine roles. Field inspection, disputed liability, injury negotiations, and complex commercial claims still require site visits and face-to-face judgment. Claims professionals will shift from case volume toward case complexity and quality.
ai_s2_accel: Fraud models identify suspicious claim signals
Intelligent search of past claims
Remote video inspection
Intelligent medical-cost comparisons
ai_s2_auto: Automated image-based damage assessment
Automated claims document review
Policy matching and payout estimates
Automated standardized reports
ai_s3_list: Field inspection: reconstruct events from physical details.
Liability decisions: classify facts against policy terms.
Negotiation: work with all parties to reach an outcome.
Investigative instinct: detect fabrication and exaggeration.
Domain expertise: apply specialized medical or engineering knowledge.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places claims work in the moderate-high exposure range for insurance roles. Damage assessment, review, and reporting are digitizing quickly. Routine claims roles face high pressure, while liability decisions, injury negotiations, and fraud investigations still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure makes complex claims the strongest path. Build expertise in medical injury, liability, or engineering claims. Use AI for initial review, then apply human judgment and negotiation. People become more valuable as cases become more complex.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Insurance, law, or finance provides a strong academic foundation. Complete an internship at an insurer and learn the auto and commercial claims process. Strong English can open paths into reinsurance and international insurers.

Move toward specialist lines and expert roles. Pursue loss-adjusting credentials and build expertise in medical or engineering claims. Learn AI damage-assessment tools, then spend your time on negotiation and investigation.

Sales, customer service, and legal backgrounds transfer well into claims. Start as a damage-assessment assistant, learn the process, and pursue claims credentials. In interviews, demonstrate resilience, logic, and communication with a difficult dispute you resolved.
Tier the claims team's work. Route simple cases to AI and external providers, and assign experienced employees to complex cases. Training in loss adjusting and reinsurance helps retain core talent.

ai_s7_trends: AI damage assessment and automated review continue to reduce simple claims roles.
Claims work is shifting toward complex liability, injury, and fraud cases.
Credentialed loss adjusters and specialists in complex insurance lines are in greater demand.

body: Claims Adjusters, Examiners, And Investigators inspect losses, determine damage and liability, review documents, and negotiate insurance payments. They investigate accidents and suspicious details, prevent fraud, and promote fair claim outcomes.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can produce a damage estimate in minutes and search past claims instantly, but people still judge responsibility and negotiate the outcome.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能三分钟出定损单、秒查历史赔案，但「这次事故到底谁的责任、话术怎么谈」这种判断和博弈，还得靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年理赔核损员、审查员与调查员在岗约 35.61 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 33.79 万人，岗位净减约 1.82 万个，年均产生约 2.11 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.68 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会重构但不会取消理赔岗：图片定损、自动审核、反欺诈模型已经在处理大量简单车险案，把低端案子的需求砍掉一大块；而现场查勘、责任争议、人伤谈判和复杂财险，需要跑现场、面对面博弈，这些 AI 替代不了。理赔员会从「量」转向「质」。
ai_s2_accel: 反欺诈模型识别骗保线索
历史赔案智能检索
远程视频查勘
医疗费用智能比对
ai_s2_auto: 图片定损自动评估
理赔资料自动审核
条款匹配与赔付试算
标准化报告自动生成
ai_s3_list: 现场查勘：从细节还原事故过程。
责任判断：条款与事实的交叉定性。
谈判能力：跟各方博弈拿结果。
疑点嗅觉：识别伪造与夸大。
专业深耕：医疗、工程等专项知识。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明理赔是「中高曝光」的保险岗位：定损、审核、报告这些环节数字化极快，简单案子的操作岗风险大，但责任认定、人伤谈判和反欺诈仍需人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着必须往「复杂案子」挤：深耕医疗人伤、责任险、工程险，把 AI 当初审工具，你负责判断和谈判——越复杂的案子，人越值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学保险、法律、金融专业是正路，大学期间多去保险公司实习，把车险财险流程跑一遍；英语好的可以往再保险和外资保险公司方向规划。
往专业险种和专家岗走：考公估师、保险公估人资质，深耕医疗或工程理赔；把 AI 定损工具用熟，你的时间应该花在谈判和调查上。
销售、客服、法律背景转理赔有优势：先做核损助理熟悉流程，再考理赔资格；面试时突出抗压、逻辑和沟通，讲一个你处理过的扯皮案例最加分。
理赔团队效率靠分层：简单案交给 AI 和外包，把资深员工作放在复杂案上；给员工考公估师、再保险培训的机会，是留住核心人才的关键。

ai_s7_trends: AI 定损与自动审核普及，简单理赔岗位持续收缩。
理赔重心转向复杂责任、人伤与反欺诈。
持证公估师与专业险种理赔人才更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automatic car washes can remove mud, but your hands and eyes still handle crumbs in seat seams and paintwork that customers want treated carefully.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 410,100 Cleaners Of Vehicles And Equipment were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 426,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 16,100 jobs, with about 56,200 annual job openings. The median annual salary is about $35,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation have limited but clear effects on vehicle and equipment cleaning. Automatic car washes and robotic scrubbers are taking over standardized exterior washing. Detailed interior cleaning, stubborn stain removal, and customer communication remain core human tasks because they involve irregular conditions and manual judgment. Cleaners who offer higher-value services can become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Smart car-wash equipment reduces manual exterior washing
Trials of robotic interior vacuuming and disinfection
Car-wash SaaS and membership systems expand
Unstaffed car-wash sites expand in cities
ai_s2_auto: Automatic car washes complete standard exterior washing
Robotic scrubbers clean body panels
Self-service car washes replace manual rinsing
Digital cleaning records and payment
ai_s3_list: Detailed interior cleaning: reach seams, leather, and special stains that machines miss.
Stubborn-stain experience: choose the right chemical and soaking method for oil, asphalt, and bird droppings.
Customer service: understand the requested result and explain the safest approach.
Vehicle and equipment judgment: know which cleaning agents can damage each material.
Physical efficiency: clean many vehicles each day without sacrificing quality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in the relatively low exposure range. Machines and software assist only a few standardized steps, including exterior washing, vacuuming, and payment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean zero risk. Automatic car washes reduce some basic exterior-washing jobs, while detailed interior cleaning and customer service depend more heavily on people. Workers limited to basic exterior washing face the greatest risk. Added-value skills and customer retention improve stability.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This is better treated as a transitional job than a primary field of study. For a long-term path, learn automotive detailing, film installation, and protective coating instead of stopping at basic washing.

Learn detailed interior cleaning, waxing, coating, and film installation, then serve higher-end customers. Moving from car washer to detailing technician and customer-service specialist creates a large income difference.
Entry is available at any time. Start at a reputable car wash and learn the full process. On your résumé, list the services you perform, daily vehicle volume, and any repeat customers.
Do not hire basic car-wash workers only on piece rates. Employees who learn detailing and serve customers deserve training and development time, which also reduces turnover.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Cover the vehicle evenly with foam
Wash vehicles in volume without staff
Clean seats and carpets at high temperature
Manage bookings, memberships, and prepaid balances

ai_s7_trends: Automatic and unstaffed car washes reduce basic exterior-washing jobs. Workers shift toward detailed interior cleaning and added-value detailing.
Vehicle ownership and premium detailing demand support higher pay for technicians skilled in waxing, coating, and film installation.
Shops are moving from washing alone to integrated cleaning, detailing, and maintenance. Workers who serve customers and lead teams gain advancement options.

body: Cleaners Of Vehicles And Equipment wash and maintain vehicles, machinery, equipment, and tools. Their work includes exterior rinsing, drying, interior cleaning, and surface care. This essential service protects appearance and equipment operation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动洗车机能冲掉泥，但座椅缝隙里的面包屑、客户指定要照顾的漆面，还得靠你的手和眼。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年清洁工设备在岗约 41.01 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 42.62 万人，净增约 1.61 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.62 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.53 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和自动化对车辆与设备清洁工的影响有限，但方向明确：自动洗车机、机器人擦洗正在接管标准化外洗。留下的核心是内饰精细清洁、顽固污渍处理和客户沟通——这些「非标准、要手感」的活，机器短期内干不好。会做增值服务的清洁工，反而越做越值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 智能洗车设备普及挤压人工外洗
机器人内饰吸尘与消毒试用
洗车 SaaS 与会员系统覆盖
无人洗车站点在城市扩张
ai_s2_auto: 自动洗车机完成标准外洗
机器人擦洗车身面板
自助洗车场替代人工冲洗
清洁记录与收费电子化
ai_s3_list: 内饰精细清洁：缝隙、皮革、特殊污渍，机器够不着的地方。
顽固污渍的处理经验：油污、沥青、鸟粪，用什么剂、怎么泡。
客户服务的分寸：客户要什么效果，怎么沟通最稳妥。
设备与车辆的判断：什么材质不能碰什么清洁剂。
体力与效率的平衡：一天几十台车，又快又干净是本事。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这行只有少数标准化环节正在被自动化——外洗、吸尘、收费，机器和软件都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于零风险。自动洗车机确实会挤掉一部分基础外洗岗位，但内饰精细清洁和客户服务反而更依赖人。真正该担心的是「只做基础外洗」，会增值服务、能留住客户的清洁工更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不建议作为主要升学方向，但可作为过渡就业选项。想长期做，往汽车美容、贴膜、镀晶等技术性方向学，别停在基础冲洗。
把内饰精洗、打蜡镀膜、贴膜这些增值技能学起来，主动服务高端客户。从「洗车工」升级为「美容技师+客户服务」，收入差距很大。
随时可入行，先去正规洗车店学全套流程。简历上多写「会哪些清洁项目、一天处理多少台车、有没有稳定客户」。
别只按件付钱招基础洗车工。愿意学美容技能、能服务客户的员工，值得给培训和时间，流失率也会低。

ai_s7_trends: 自动洗车与无人洗车站点扩张，基础外洗岗位减少，清洁工向「内饰精洗+美容增值」转型。
汽车保有量与高端洗美需求增长，会打蜡镀膜、贴膜的技师收入更高、更抢手。
门店从「洗车」转向「洗美养护一站式」，能服务客户、会带团队的清洁工有晋升空间。

body: 车辆与设备清洁工负责清洗与保养车辆、机械设备及工具，包括外部冲洗、擦干、内饰清洁与表面养护，是保障车辆形象与设备运转的基础服务岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can score a depression scale in five seconds, but someone across the room still has to gently ask, "Have you been especially tired lately?"
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Clinical And Counseling Psychologists is projected to rise from about 76,300 in 2024 to 84,800 in 2034, a net increase of about 8,500 jobs, with around 4,800 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $95,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Clinical And Counseling Psychologists, but it will take over much of assessment and documentation. Scale administration, initial screening, case notes, and report drafts are rapidly shifting to AI. Interviews, empathy, the therapeutic relationship, and crisis intervention depend on human presence; machines cannot enter the heart of the consulting room.
ai_s2_accel: AI voice analysis that helps identify emotional risk signals
Digital cognitive training and self-help intervention programs
Online therapist collaboration and supervision platforms
Large-scale data research that supports treatment-outcome analysis
ai_s2_auto: Administering and automatically scoring psychological scales
Initial screening and risk-assessment questionnaires
Generating case notes and report drafts
Automating appointment scheduling and follow-up reminders
ai_s3_list: Therapeutic relationships: counseling works only when clients feel safe enough to lower their defenses.
Empathy and presence: AI can identify anxiety, but it cannot hold the person behind the anxiety.
Clinical judgment: scales provide clues, while diagnosis and risk decisions depend on integrated experience.
Crisis intervention: when suicide risk emerges on a call, a person must immediately ask, "Are you safe right now?" and provide stability.
Ethics and boundaries: only people can navigate the nuances of confidentiality, referral, and dual relationships.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate AI exposure tier because assessment, documentation, and screening make up a meaningful share of the work and AI tools are rapidly taking them over.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. By making assessment faster and more accurate, AI pushes therapists deeper into relationship-centered work, a domain AI cannot reach. Roles built around assembly-line counseling based only on scales face pressure, while therapists with strong case experience remain scarce.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Do not study psychology expecting to provide counseling immediately after a bachelor's degree. Clinical counseling typically requires a master's degree, systematic training, and supervision. Pursue internships and supervision groups as an undergraduate to test whether you can sustain emotionally demanding work.

Treat AI assessment tools as assistants and use the saved time to strengthen casework and supervision. Maintain supervision and personal therapy to guard against vicarious trauma, and build a specialty in areas such as children, relationships, or addiction.

Approach a career change with clear expectations: this path is long and expensive. Begin with systematic training and pro bono cases instead of paying heavily for a fast-track counselor certificate. Backgrounds in education, healthcare, or HR provide useful advantages.

When hiring therapists, look beyond collections of certificates to case hours, supervision records, and ethical conduct. Discussing how a candidate handled a real case reveals competence best, and organizations that provide supervision are better able to retain people.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Scale administration, automatic scoring, and reporting
Alerts for changes in tone and speaking rate
Rapid retrieval of therapies and literature

ai_s7_trends: As AI takes over scales and screening, therapists regain time for the consulting room and assessment efficiency rises sharply.
Psychological services are expanding in schools, companies, and online platforms, with growing demand in specialties such as children, workplace issues, and relationships.
Stronger professional self-regulation and supervision systems make case experience a career dividing line, while certificate inflation accelerates the removal of underqualified practitioners.

body: Clinical And Counseling Psychologists apply psychological theories and methods to assess, diagnose, counsel, and provide psychotherapy to individuals. They help clients manage emotional distress, psychological disorders, and life crises, and also conduct mental health education and research.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能五秒钟算出抑郁量表分数，但「你最近是不是特别累」这句话，得有人在对面轻轻说出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年临床与咨询心理学家在岗约 7.63 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 8.48 万人，净增约 0.85 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.48 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.58 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代临床与咨询心理学家，但会接管评估与文书。量表施测、初步筛查、个案记录、报告草稿，这些正被 AI 快速接手。剩下的面询、共情、治疗关系、危机干预，全是在场的活，机器进不了咨询室的核心。
ai_s2_accel: AI 语音分析辅助识别情绪风险线索
数字化认知训练与自助干预程序
治疗师在线协作与督导平台
大数据研究辅助疗效分析
ai_s2_auto: 心理量表施测与自动计分
初步筛查与风险评估问卷
个案记录与报告草稿生成
预约排班与随访提醒自动化
ai_s3_list: 治疗关系：来访者愿意在谁面前脱下面具，是咨询有效的前提。
共情与在场感：AI 能识别「焦虑」，但接不住「焦虑背后的那个人」。
临床判断：量表只是线索，诊断和风险判断靠的是综合经验。
危机干预：自杀风险电话里那句「你现在安全吗」，需要人立刻给出稳定感。
伦理与边界：保密、转介、双重关系的分寸，只有人能把握。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的评估、记录、筛查比重不小，这些正被 AI 工具快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 把评估做快做准，反而把治疗师推向「关系的深水区」——那是 AI 永远到不了的地方。真正被挤压的是「只靠量表做流水咨询」的岗位，有扎实个案经验的治疗师依然稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读心理学别指望「本科毕业就能咨询」。想走临床咨询，做好硕士加系统受训加督导的长期准备；本科阶段多实习、多参加督导小组，先确认自己是否受得了高强度的情绪工作。
把 AI 评估工具当助手而不是对手，省下时间打磨个案和督导。守住督导与个人体验，这是防止替代性创伤的护身符；往儿童、婚恋、成瘾等细分方向积累壁垒。
转行要清醒：这条路长且贵。建议先做系统受训并积累公益个案，别一上来就重金砸「速成咨询师证」。有教育、医疗、HR 背景的人转型有优势。
招治疗师别只看证书堆，看个案时长、督导记录和伦理操守。面试时聊一个真实个案的处理过程，最能看出成色；提供督导支持的组织更能留人。

行业自律与督导体系完善，个案经验成为职业分水岭，证书通胀加速出清。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 78,000 Database Administrators were employed in 2024, declining to a projected 77,500 by 2034. That represents about 500 fewer jobs, with roughly 3,800 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $104,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Database Administrators, but it will reduce standard operations work. Managed cloud services and automated operations accelerate backup and monitoring, shifting DBAs from watching alerts toward architecture, tuning, and disaster recovery. People limited to standard operations face pressure, while those who design and tune systems become more valuable.

Index recommendations
Capacity forecasting
Anomaly Alerts

Positions will not be cleared overnight, but the number of assistant positions will continue to be reduced, leaving only the "human flesh and blood" parts: abnormal case handling, employee emotional communication, and cross-department coordination. If you don’t want to be replaced, you have to go to a specialist position with judgment.

RPA robots automate repetitive operations

ai_s3_list: Employee communication: policy explanation and emotional comfort, machines cannot provide warmth.
Exception handling: cases, special cases and boundary issues outside the system.
Responsibility for details: Files, contracts, and data have extremely low error tolerance.
Cross-department coordination: Liaise with finance, administration, and business lines.
Professional judgment: Translate business experience into understanding of human resources.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 shows that the core actions of this industry - screening, statistics, and sorting - are exactly the areas where AI is best at, and they belong to professions with "clear alternative paths".
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium and high exposure means high risk: if you stay at the transaction execution level, there is a high probability of being replaced by HR systems and AI. But think about it conversely, the system does the chores for you, which just saves time for transformation - taking the human resources certificate, learning about salary and performance, taking on recruitment projects, upgrading from "processing" to "making judgments", only then can the value of the position be preserved.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Learning human resource management requires two legs: "methods + tools": you need to understand the six modules, but also data analysis and AI tools. Don't expect to work as an assistant for a lifetime. You have planned to become a specialist or BP since your freshman year. Internships are more important than endorsements.

Start the transition now: choose one specialty, such as recruiting, employee relations, or compensation and performance, and become proficient with HR systems and AI tools. Earn an HR credential and take ownership of projects so your resume shows results, not just completed tasks.

The assistant position is suitable as a springboard to enter the HR industry, but there must be a clear upgrade plan. When applying for a job, emphasize which HR systems and data analysis tools you can use. Being able to independently run through the entire recruitment or onboarding and exit process is more competitive than general "administrative personnel experience."

Don’t recruit assistants as “system operators”. AI can already replace most of the operations. Recruit people who are willing to learn and can grow into specialists, and provide supporting training and promotion channels - an assistant who can handle recruitment projects is worth several times more than an ordinary operator.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 简历初筛和通知群发都交给 AI 了，HR 助理的位置在哪？答案：在转型的岔路口上。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 对人力资源助理的冲击是「最典型的那一类」：简历初筛、面试通知、考勤统计、表格整理——这些占助理大半时间的事务动作，AI 与 HR 系统正在快速接管。岗位不会一夜清零，但助理岗的数量会持续压缩，剩下的是「人肉兜底」的部分：异常案例处理、员工情绪沟通、跨部门协调。不想被替代，就得往有判断力的专员岗走。

员工咨询机器人值班答疑

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光就是高风险：停留在事务执行层，被 HR 系统和 AI 替代是大概率。但反过来想，系统替你做杂活，正好省下时间转型——考人力资源证书、学薪酬绩效、接招聘项目，从「办流程」升级成「做判断」，岗位价值才能保住。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学人力资源管理要「方法 + 工具」两条腿：既要懂六大模块，也要会数据分析与 AI 工具。别指望助理岗吃一辈子，从大一就规划往专员、BP 方向走，实习比背书重要。
立刻启动转型：选一个方向深耕——招聘、员工关系或薪酬绩效，同时把 HR 系统与 AI 工具用熟。考 HR 相关证书补专业背书，主动接项目做，让简历从「办过事」变成「做成过事」。
助理岗适合作为 HR 入行跳板，但要有明确的升级计划。求职时强调你会用哪些 HR 系统和数据分析工具，能独立跑通招聘或入离职全流程，比泛泛的「行政人事经验」有竞争力。
别把助理当「系统操作员」招，AI 已能替代大半操作。招有学习意愿、能往专员方向成长的人，配套培训与晋升通道——一个能扛招聘项目的助理，价值是普通操作员的几倍。

ai_s7_trends: HR 系统与 AI 工具全面接管事务层，助理岗持续收缩。
HR 岗位重心向专业判断与业务伙伴转型，专员与 BP 需求稳定。
员工体验成为 HR 工作重点，沟通与温度成为稀缺能力。

物品登记与归还记录上系统
消耗品库存盘点自动化
ai_s3_list: 面对面的服务温度：递毛巾时的一个微笑，比任何系统都暖。
突发情况处理：钥匙丢了、物品拿错了、客人起了争执，需要现场应变。
安全巡查与隐患判断：哪些角落该盯、哪个柜子没关好，靠的是经验。
个性化关怀：记住熟客的偏好——这位大哥喜欢大毛巾，那位女士自带水杯。
卫生死角的细致清洁：机器扫得到地面，扫不到犄角旮旯的细节。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业绝大部分任务是非结构化的面对面服务，AI 能接走的只是一小部分登记、盘点类杂活。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：自助化会减少「纯收发」的岗位，但康养、健身、剧院这些线下业态在扩张，岗位重心会从「发钥匙」转向「管秩序、做服务」。对愿意提升服务能力的人来说，这不是坏消息。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不建议作为长期职业目标，但作为学生兼职练沟通能力不错。如果孩子喜欢这行，往酒店管理、康养服务管理方向升学，天花板高得多。
把服务意识打磨成招牌，同时主动学点管理技能——班组长、领班、康养会所主管都是晋升方向。别只满足于「发手牌」。
这行是很好的过渡岗：门槛低、能练服务沟通。简历上别只写「收发物品」，写你处理过多少次纠纷、服务过多少客人，转去酒店、零售、康养都算履历。
招人时别只盯「勤快」，要盯「靠得住」。收银台前的诚信、处理遗失物的细致、高峰期的情绪稳定，这些比手脚快慢更重要。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 电子手环/人脸识别开柜，减少人工收发

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can update records automatically, but people still decide which batch takes priority, how to resolve discrepancies, and how to coordinate the floor.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 2,764,800 Stock Clerks And Order Fillers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 2,999,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 235,000 jobs, with around 472,300 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $37,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Stock Clerks And Order Fillers, but it will reduce basic roles. WMS and automated picking accelerate routine checks, shifting workers from ledgers toward exception handling, discrepancy analysis, floor dispatch, and coordinated shipping. Mechanical checkers face pressure, while strong on-site coordinators gain value.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent discrepancy alerts
Intelligent wave scheduling
Automatic out-of-stock alerts
Order-filling quality checks
ai_s2_auto: Automatic receiving through barcode scanning
Automatic inventory updates
Picking-route optimization
Electronic ledger generation
ai_s3_list: Exception handling: people judge errors.
Floor coordination: people adjust the pace.
Discrepancy analysis: people find root causes.
Customer coordination: people communicate.
Emergency dispatch: people make tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure tier. Systems accelerate basic checks, while exceptions and coordination still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces mechanical checking, not floor coordination. Workers who handle discrepancies and understand operations become scarcer, while barcode-only clerks face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in logistics and practice both systems and floor operations. Pure checking is contracting, so learn exception handling early.
Advance from ledger entry to discrepancy management and floor coordination, learn WMS, and pursue responsibility for an area.
Highlight accuracy and warehouse experience, clearly identifying the facilities handled. Employers value stability and precision.
When hiring, look beyond speed and assess operational judgment. Core workers who handle exceptions deserve performance incentives.

ai_s7_trends: WMS spreads, reducing basic roles.
Automated picking improves efficiency.
Professionals with strong on-site capabilities are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动记账，但哪批货要优先、怎么处理差异、现场怎么协调，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年库存文员与订单配货员在岗约 276.48 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 299.98 万人，净增约 23.50 万个岗位，年均产生约 47.23 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代库存文员与配货员，但会压缩基础岗。WMS 与自动拣货把常规核对提速，从业者从「记台账」挪向「异常处理、差异分析、现场调度、协同发货」。真正被挤掉的是只做机械核对的，有现场力能协调的人更值钱。

现场协调：节奏靠人调。
差异分析：根因靠人查。
客户对接：沟通靠人。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的仓储区——基础核对被系统加速，但异常与协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「机械核对」动作，不是「现场协调」的岗位。有现场力、能处理差异的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会扫条码的文员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 物流起步多练系统与现场，AI 时代纯核对在缩，早点练异常。
从「记台账」升级成「管差异 + 调现场」，学 WMS，争取片区。
突出准确率与现场经验，写清跟过哪些仓。企业看重稳和准。
选人别只看手快，要看有没有现场脑子。能处理异常的骨干，值得给绩效。

自动拣货带来效率。
有现场力的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can schedule projects and write funding reports, but every research manager's judgment about whether a direction still deserves investment or why a scientist wants to leave affects real money and real people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 104,300 natural sciences managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 108,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,900 jobs, with roughly 8,500 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $161,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace natural sciences managers, but it will change their management tools. AI is sharply reducing paperwork such as project schedules, funding reports, literature reviews, and presentations, giving managers more time for real decisions: selecting directions, allocating resources, and motivating teams. Managing the complexity of people is where AI performs worst.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted forecasting and selection of R&D directions
Intelligent analysis of research data and experiment reports
Talent profiling and recruitment screening
Commercialization assessment and patent analysis
ai_s2_auto: Automated project scheduling and progress tracking
Automatic generation of funding and budget reports
Faster literature reviews and intelligence searches
Batch organization of presentations and documents
ai_s3_list: Direction setting: deciding whether to invest amid uncertainty.
Resource allocation: directing limited funding to the most valuable work.
Team leadership: motivating scientists and resolving conflict.
Cross-department coordination: connecting technology, markets, and capital.
Risk management: anticipating failure and limiting losses early.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 means the information side of research management is highly compatible with AI. Plans, reports, literature, and assessments consist of text and data that AI handles far faster than people. The real difficulty is managing people, including reading team conditions and committing to uncertain directions, which has low automation potential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure is a reminder not to spend your time on documents. Let AI handle reports and materials, and spend your time meeting teams, negotiating partnerships, and thinking about direction. A manager's value lies in judgment, not spreadsheet production.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To become a research manager, first build a strong scientific foundation, typically through a master's or doctoral degree, then deliberately develop management skills. Seek opportunities to lead groups and manage projects as a student, and take management courses in graduate school to prepare for future leadership roles.

Scientists moving into management should actively learn project management, funding compliance, and team motivation. Let AI handle documentation while you invest time in people and direction, where your attention matters most.

If you have an R&D background and want to move into management, begin with a transitional role such as technical lead. In interviews, explain the teams and projects you have led and how you handled funding and personnel challenges. This is more persuasive than discussing technical outputs alone.

The hardest research managers to recruit are people respected by scientists who also understand operations. Sufficient authority and decision-making space retain them better than salary alone. Establish clear dual advancement tracks for R&D talent.

ai_s7_trends: Continued investment in hard technology and biopharmaceutical R&D increases demand for managers.
AI accelerates R&D, increasing the importance of direction setting and resource allocation.
R&D organizations become flatter, shifting managers from managing projects to building platforms.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能排项目计划、能写经费报表，但「这个方向还值不值得投、那个科学家为什么想走」，科研经理的每一次判断都关乎真金白银和人心。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年自然科学领域经理在岗约 10.43 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.82 万人，净增约 0.39 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 16.12 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代自然科学领域经理，但会改变管理的工具面：项目排期、经费报表、文献综述、汇报材料这些文书工作正被 AI 大幅压缩，经理能腾出更多时间做真正的决策——方向选择、资源分配、团队激励。管理「人」的复杂度，是 AI 最不擅长的领域。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助研发方向预测与选题
科研数据与实验报告智能分析
人才画像与招聘筛选
成果转化评估与专利分析
ai_s2_auto: 项目排期与进度跟踪自动化
经费与预算报表自动生成
文献综述与情报检索加速
汇报材料与文档批量整理
ai_s3_list: 方向判断：在不确定性里决定投不投。
资源分配：有限的经费给最值的方向。
团队领导：激励科学家、调解冲突。
跨部门协调：链接技术、市场、资本。
风险管理：预见失败并提前止损。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明科研管理的「信息面」高度 AI 友好：计划、报表、文献、评估都是文本和数据，AI 处理效率远超人工；但管理真正的难点是「人」——如何判断团队状态、如何拍板不确定的方向，这部分的自动化程度很低。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光提醒你：别把时间耗在文档上。用 AI 把报表和材料做掉，把时间花在见团队、谈合作、想方向上——管理者的价值在判断，不在产出表格。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想当科研经理，先要有扎实的科研底子（硕博是标配），再刻意培养管理能力：学生时代就争取带小组、管项目；读研时选修管理课程，为将来转管理岗铺路。
从科学家转管理要主动补课：项目管理、经费合规、团队激励都要学；同时让 AI 处理文书，把时间投向人和方向——这是你最该做的事。
有研发背景想转管理，先找「技术负责人」这类过渡岗；面试时讲清楚你带过什么团队、管过什么项目、怎么处理过经费和人事难题，比讲技术成果更有说服力。
科研经理难招的是「既服众又懂经营」的人；给管理者足够的授权和决策空间，比单纯高薪更能留住人；同时建立清晰的研发人才晋升双通道。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can schedule tomorrow's treatments and document training, but when a patient's face turns pale and hands shake while being helped onto a treatment table, your eyes and hands must decide whether training can continue.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 5,200 occupational therapy aides were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 5,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 100 jobs, with roughly 600 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $37,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace occupational therapy aides, but it will take over scheduling, records, and equipment inventories. Hands-on transfers, training support, companionship, and observation of patient condition all require face-to-face human care.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted rehabilitation equipment adjusts parameters from data
Wearable devices monitor patient movement quality in real time
Video motion analysis helps aides correct training posture
AI recommends rehabilitation-plan templates from assessment results
ai_s2_auto: Automated management of schedules and appointments
Automatic generation of training notes and medical documentation
Digital equipment registers and supply inventories
Automatic organization and statistics for rehabilitation progress data
ai_s3_list: Transfers and positioning care: safely supporting patients without injuring them or yourself requires hands-on skill.
Observing patient responses: people must first notice changes in complexion, breathing, and expression.
Trust and communication with patients: patience is needed to reassure older patients who resist cooperation.
On-site adaptability: respond quickly when equipment breaks or a patient suddenly feels unwell.
Coordination with therapists: anticipating what a therapist needs from one look comes from long experience together.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 reflects the substantial share of scheduling, records, and inventories in this occupation, tasks software and AI are taking over. Core on-site assistance and patient care remain highly human-dependent.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean the job disappears. AI saves time on records and schedules so aides can focus on patients. Purely administrative aides who only handle errands and do not learn rehabilitation skills face pressure, while aides with basic assessment knowledge and new-equipment skills become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you want a rehabilitation career, do not stop at aide. Study rehabilitation therapy technology or nursing and build foundations in anatomy, assessment, and therapeutic techniques. Learn rehabilitation-assistance equipment in the AI era and aim for therapist certification.

Let software handle schedules and records, and use the saved time to learn therapists' techniques. Prioritize organizations that develop aides into therapists. Do not let aide remain your job label for ten years.

Rehabilitation aide is a low-barrier entry point for testing the industry. Understand that aide-only income has a low ceiling, while becoming a therapist requires additional education and certification. Calculate the time cost before transitioning.

Do not hire aides based only on efficiency. Prioritize rehabilitation or nursing fundamentals and the ability to observe patients. Organizations that fund aide training and therapist certification retain people at clearly higher rates.

Compare standard movements to identify deviations
Information synchronization between therapists and aides

ai_s7_trends: Rehabilitation organizations broadly digitize schedules, records, and equipment registers, reducing aides' administrative burden.
As intelligent rehabilitation equipment enters facilities, aides who operate new devices and understand basic assessment become more competitive.
Population aging drives rehabilitation demand, but demand narrows for aides limited to errands, shifting toward assistants who understand care and can become therapists.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能排好明天的治疗表、写清训练记录，但扶病人上训练台时他脸色发白、手在抖，能不能继续练，还得靠你的眼睛和手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年作业治疗助理在岗约 0.52 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.53 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代作业治疗助理，但会接管排班、记录和器械台账。剩下的扶抱协助、陪伴训练、观察病人状态，全是面对面的事，机器替不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助的康复训练设备按数据调参
可穿戴设备实时监测病人动作质量
视频动作分析帮助理纠正训练姿势
康复计划模板由 AI 按评估结果推荐
ai_s2_auto: 排班与预约系统自动管理
训练记录与病历文书自动生成
器械台账与耗材库存数字化
康复进度数据的自动整理统计
ai_s3_list: 扶抱与体位护理：怎么扶不让病人受伤、也不伤自己，是手上的功夫。
观察病人反应：脸色、呼吸、表情变了要先察觉，机器没这本事。
与病人的信任沟通：老年病人不配合时怎么哄、怎么安抚，靠的是耐心。
现场应变：器械临时坏了、病人突然不舒服，怎么快速处理。
与治疗师的默契配合：治疗师一个眼神你就知道要递什么，是长期磨合。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的排班、记录、台账比重不小，这些正被软件与 AI 接管，但核心的现场协助与病人照护仍高度依赖人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于岗位消失。AI 会把「写记录、排班表」的时间省下来，让你把精力放到病人身上。真正被挤压的是「只会打杂、不愿学康复技能」的纯事务型助理；懂一点评估配合、会操作新设备的助理反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走康复这条路，别停在助理——选康复治疗技术或护理专业，把解剖、评估、手法训练基础打牢。AI 时代更要学会用康复辅助设备，目标是考康复治疗师证。
把排班、记录交给软件，把省下的时间用来学治疗师的操作手法。机构里愿意让助理往治疗师方向培养的，优先考虑。别让「助理」变成十年不变的岗位标签。
康复助理是低门槛入口，适合先入行感受行业。但要想清楚：只做助理收入天花板低，转治疗师要补学历和考证，转行前先算好时间成本。
招助理别只看「手脚麻利」，优先看有没有康复护理基础、会不会观察病人。愿意出钱送助理培训考治疗师证的机构，留人率明显更高。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 治疗师与助理信息同步

ai_s7_trends: 康复机构普遍数字化：排班、记录、器械台账都上系统，助理的事务性负担减轻。
智能康复设备进机构，会操作新设备、懂基本评估的助理更吃香。
老龄化加深带动康复需求，但行业对「只会打杂的助理」需求在收窄，向「懂协助、可转治疗师」升级。

body: 作业治疗助理在作业治疗师或作业治疗助理师指导下，负责治疗场地与器械的准备维护，协助病人进行日常作业训练（穿衣、进食、手部功能等），并承担记录。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能排好明天的治疗表、写清训练记录，但扶病人上训练台时他脸色发白、手在抖，能不能继续练，还得靠你的眼睛和手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can run optimization automatically, but people still define the problem, set the objectives, and drive solutions through the organization.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that in 2024, about 112,100 operations research analysts were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 136,200, a net increase of about 24,100 jobs, with about 9,600 openings generated per year. In 2026, the median annual salary is about $91,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace operations research analysts, but it will shift the focus of their work. Automated optimization and low-code tools are absorbing standard modeling, moving analysts from writing models toward defining problems, aligning with the business, driving implementation, and handling complex constraints. Those limited to template-based modeling face displacement, while people who can turn models into decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Automated constraint extraction
Intelligent solution recommendations
Automated sensitivity analysis
Batch scenario simulation
ai_s2_auto: Standard optimization solving
Automated parameter tuning
Low-code modeling
Automated report generation
ai_s3_list: Problem definition: people uncover the pain points.
Business alignment: people set the objectives.
Complex constraints: people make the trade-offs.
Implementation: people move the organization.
Communicating conclusions: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 indicates relatively high AI exposure. Tools accelerate modeling, but people retain a central role in problem definition and implementation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not mean high risk. Template-based modeling tasks face replacement, not the role of solving problems rigorously and implementing solutions. Analysts who align with the business become even scarcer as tools improve productivity.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you start in mathematics or industrial engineering, practice business communication extensively. Pure modeling is shrinking in the AI era, so develop problem-definition skills early.
Move from running models to explaining decisions and driving implementation. Learn the language of business and how to manage pilots.
Highlight project outcomes and actual savings, and clearly state which business lines you have supported.
Do not assess candidates on mathematics alone. Evaluate whether they can translate a model into a solution the business can implement.

ai_s7_trends: Optimization tools are becoming widely accessible, lowering entry barriers.
Demand for complex, cross-domain problem solving is rising.
Analysts who understand the business are in greater demand.

body: Operations research analysts use mathematical models, statistics, and algorithms to diagnose and optimize organizational operating systems and propose practical solutions for efficiency and resource allocation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can run optimization automatically, but people still define the problem, set the objectives, and drive solutions through the organization.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动跑优化，但问题怎么界、目标怎么定、方案怎么推过组织，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年运筹学分析师在岗约 11.21 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.62 万人，净增约 2.41 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.96 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.13 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代运筹分析员，但会改变工作重心。自动优化与低代码工具吃掉标准建模，分析员从「写模型」挪向「界定问题、对齐业务、推动落地、处理复杂约束」。真正被挤掉的是只做模板化建模的，能把模型讲成决策的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 约束自动抽取
方案智能推荐
敏感性自动跑
场景批量仿真
ai_s2_auto: 标准优化求解
自动参数调优
低代码建模
报表自动生成
ai_s3_list: 问题界定：痛点靠人挖。
业务对齐：目标靠人定。
复杂约束：权衡靠人。
落地推动：组织靠人。
结论讲述：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——建模被工具加速，但界定与推动还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「模板化建模」动作，不是「把问题算清楚并推落地」的岗位。能对齐业务的人，反而随工具提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 数学/工业工程起步多练业务沟通，AI 时代纯建模在缩，早点练界定。
从「跑模型」升级成「讲决策 + 推落地」，学业务语言和试点管理。
突出项目成果和省的实钱，写清服务过哪些业务线。
选人别只看数学，要看会不会把模型讲成业务能落地的方案。

ai_s7_trends: 优化工具下沉，门槛降。
复杂跨域问题需求升。
懂业务的分析更抢手。

body: 运筹分析员运用数学模型、统计学与算法，诊断并优化组织的运营系统，提出可落地的效率与资源配置方案。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动跑优化，但问题怎么界、目标怎么定、方案怎么推过组织，还是人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate elevations, prepare drawings, and inspect pipes with robots, but pipelayers still crouch in muddy trenches to verify alignment and grade by hand.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 34,400 pipelayers were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to fall to 32,900, a net decrease of about 1,500 jobs, with about 2,400 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $48,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace pipelayers, but it will take over surveying and drawings. Total stations, laser grade controls, and digital layout make construction more precise, while pipeline inspection robots are spreading. Laying pipe is physical fieldwork. Pipes do not enter trenches by themselves, and people still align, grade, connect, and backfill them with their hands and eyes.
ai_s2_accel: Precise laying assisted by laser grade controls and total stations
Trenchless directional drilling that reduces excavation
BIM/GIS-assisted underground utility management
Rapid acceptance inspection through pipeline CCTV
ai_s2_auto: Digital surveying, layout, and elevation calculations
Digital construction drawings and documentation
Automatic inspections by pipeline robots
Digital construction records and acceptance documents
ai_s3_list: Drawing interpretation and layout: transfer drawing elevations into trenches.
Alignment skill: on-site judgment for pipe-end alignment and grade.
Joint treatment: connection processes for different pipe materials.
Safety awareness: anticipate trench collapse and utility risks.
Teamwork: coordinate lifting, excavation, and welding.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates that automation concentrates at the surveying and inspection layer. Digital tools assist layout, elevation, and acceptance, but pipe laying remains heavy physical fieldwork. AI cannot replace alignment, grading, and joint work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean no change. Workers who use total stations, laser grade controls, and BIM drawings work more efficiently. Inspection robots make acceptance more transparent, giving workers skilled in surveying and drawing interpretation more bargaining power than those who only provide physical labor.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Entry barriers are low and income is stable, making this suitable for resilient students. Study municipal engineering or water supply and drainage at a technical school, learn drawing interpretation and surveying, and advance toward construction technician or crew leader instead of remaining a general laborer who only moves pipes.

Learn surveying, drawing interpretation, and trenchless technology, and earn advanced credentials such as pipelayer or welder. Advance toward crew leader, construction technician, or quality inspection. Safety and skill level are the most valuable forms of experience in this field.

People with excavator, welding, or construction experience transition most smoothly. In interviews, emphasize the types of sites you have worked on and your safety record. Construction crews value skilled workers who independently cover one position.

Skilled pipelayers are difficult to recruit. Retain them through safety insurance + skill allowances + stable projects. Provide good surveying and inspection equipment and turn experienced workers' knowledge into crew standards to reduce dependence on a few individuals.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Internal pipe imaging and acceptance inspection
Install pipes beneath roads without excavation
Visualization and clash detection for underground utilities
Safe lowering of large-diameter pipe into trenches

ai_s7_trends: As trenchless directional drilling and related technologies spread, urban excavation decreases.
BIM/GIS digital utility management becomes standard in municipal work.
Renewal of aging utility networks drives long-term laying demand.

body: Pipelayers install pipelines in municipal and building projects. They excavate trenches, lay water, drainage, gas, and other pipes, align and grade sections, treat joints, and backfill and compact trenches, ensuring safe delivery according to design.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate elevations, prepare drawings, and inspect pipes with robots, but pipelayers still crouch in muddy trenches to verify alignment and grade by hand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你算标高、做图纸、机器人检测管道，但沟槽里那段管子对没对齐、坡度找没找平，还得铺设工蹲在泥水里亲手校。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年管道铺设工在岗约 3.44 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.29 万人，岗位净减约 0.15 万个，年均产生约 0.24 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.87 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代管道铺设工，但会接管测量和图纸：全站仪、激光找坡、数字化放线让施工更精准，管道检测机器人也在普及。铺设是现场体力活，管子不会自己进沟，对接、找坡、回填这些环节还得靠人的手和眼。
ai_s2_accel: 激光找坡与全站仪辅助精准铺设
非开挖定向钻技术减少开挖作业
BIM/GIS 辅助地下管线管理
管道CCTV检测快速验收
ai_s2_auto: 测量放线与标高计算数字化
施工图纸与资料的电子化
管道检测机器人的自动巡检
施工记录与验收资料电子化
ai_s3_list: 读图与放线：图纸上的标高落到沟里。
对接手艺：管口对齐、找坡的现场判断。
接口处理：不同管材的连接工艺。
安全警觉：沟槽塌方与管线风险的预判。
团队配合：吊装、挖掘、焊接的衔接。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行的自动化集中在「测量和检测层」：放线、标高、验收都有数字工具，但管道铺设的本质是现场重体力作业，对接、找坡、接口处理这些环节 AI 替不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：会用全站仪、激光找坡、看 BIM 图纸的施工员效率更高；管道检测机器人让验收更透明，懂测量和读图的工人，比纯下苦力的人更有议价空间。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 门槛不高、收入稳定，适合能吃苦的孩子。建议学市政工程、给排水相关技校专业，把读图和测量学起来，往施工员、班组长走，别只当搬管子的普工。
把测量、读图、非开挖技术学起来，考管道工、焊工等高等级证书。往班组长、施工员、质检方向走，安全和技能等级是这行最值钱的积累。
有挖机、焊工、建筑经验的转行最顺。面试时强调你干过的工地类型和安全记录，施工队很看重「能独立顶一个岗位」的熟练工。
熟练铺管工难招，用「安全保险 + 技能补贴 + 项目稳定」留人。配好测量和检测设备，把老师傅的经验做成班组标准，减少对个别熟手的依赖。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 地下管线可视化与碰撞检查

ai_s7_trends: 非开挖定向钻等技术普及，城市开挖作业减少。
BIM/GIS 数字化管线管理成为市政标配。
老旧管网更新改造带动长期铺设需求。

body: 管道铺设工指在市政与建筑工程中从事管道铺设的人员，负责给水、排水、燃气等管道的沟槽开挖、管道铺设、对接找坡、接口处理与回填夯实，保证管道系统按设计安全交付。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你算标高、做图纸、机器人检测管道，但沟槽里那段管子对没对齐、坡度找没找平，还得铺设工蹲在泥水里亲手校。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can produce a digital restoration plan in three minutes, but a clinician's hands must still test whether the tooth actually fits the patient's bite.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 900 prosthodontists were employed in 2024, projected to remain at 900 by 2034, a net increase of about 0 jobs, with about 0 openings annually and median annual pay of ≥$239,200 in 2024 (top BLS OES category, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace prosthodontists, but it will restructure design and workflows. Digital impressions, AI-assisted treatment design, and CAD/CAM production are becoming automated, lowering the barrier for routine restorations. Clinicians' value concentrates in diagnosing complex cases, performing implant surgery, adjusting occlusion, and building patient trust. These depend on accumulated clinical experience and tactile skill, and AI can only assist.
ai_s2_accel: 3D-printed guides assist implant positioning
AI analysis of occlusion and proximal contacts
Intraoral scanning supports remote collaboration with dental laboratories
Digital follow-up after implant surgery
ai_s2_auto: Digital impressions replace conventional impressions
AI-assisted restoration-plan design
CAD/CAM production of crowns and dentures
Digital clinical records and imaging
ai_s3_list: Treatment planning: weigh multiple options for complex tooth-loss cases.
Surgical technique: control implant position and angle.
Occlusal adjustment: precisely refine millimeter-scale bite contacts.
Patient communication: manage expectations and explain long-term prognosis.
Laboratory collaboration: communicate design intent accurately to technicians.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates that the design and workflow side of prosthodontics is becoming digital. CAD/CAM and AI are restructuring impressions, planning, and production, greatly improving routine restoration efficiency. Clinical judgment, surgical technique, and occlusal adjustment remain the clinician's core barriers; as AI spreads, complex cases depend even more on genuine expertise.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium exposure signals an opportunity to upgrade. Clinicians who use digital tools and AI planning improve both consultation efficiency and revenue per patient. Mastering complex procedures such as implants and full-mouth reconstruction alongside digital workflows is the most secure growth path for prosthodontists.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Dentistry is a long-cycle, high-investment field with predictable returns, and prosthodontic specialists often become more valuable with age. Students should confirm their interest in oral surgery and hands-on clinical work during undergraduate study, while families should be prepared to invest in residency training and advanced education.

Build digital-restoration and implant skills, and specialize in complex cases such as full-mouth and occlusal reconstruction. Develop your own patient reputation as well. Prosthodontists have high follow-up and referral rates, so reputation drives income.

People without formal dental education face a difficult direct transition and need to restart through the dental-education pathway. Those with dental assistant or technician backgrounds can study while working. In interviews and job applications, highlight precise manual skills and examples of patient communication.

Prosthodontists are scarce, so attract talent with equipment investment + case support + continuing-education pathways. Digital equipment can significantly improve restoration efficiency, but do not cut investment in laboratory collaboration or training. Quality and reputation protect the practice.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automated production of crowns and dentures
Online data transfer and collaborative production

ai_s7_trends: Digital impressions and CAD/CAM become widespread, greatly improving restoration-workflow efficiency.
Demand grows for implant restorations and full-mouth reconstruction, highlighting the value of clinicians who handle complex cases.
Digital workflows + complex-case capability becomes the core competitive advantage in prosthodontics.

body: Prosthodontists are dental specialists who diagnose and treat missing teeth, damaged tooth structure, and occlusal dysfunction, using implants, crowns, fixed bridges, removable dentures, and full-mouth reconstruction to restore chewing function and facial aesthetics.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can produce a digital restoration plan in three minutes, but a clinician's hands must still test whether the tooth actually fits the patient's bite.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能三分钟给出数字化修复方案，但「这颗牙在患者嘴里到底咬合顺不顺」，要靠医师的临床手感去试。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年修复牙科医师在岗约 0.09 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.09 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.00 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代修复牙科医师，但会重构「设计与流程」：数字化取模、AI 方案设计、CAD/CAM 制作都在自动化，常规修复的门槛在降低。医师的价值集中在复杂病例诊断、种植手术操作、咬合调整和医患信任上——这些是临床经验与手感的积累，AI 只能辅助。
ai_s2_accel: 3D 打印导板辅助种植定位
AI 咬合与邻接分析
口内扫描远程协同技工室
种植术后数字化随访
ai_s2_auto: 数字化取模替代传统印模
AI 辅助修复方案设计
CAD/CAM 制作牙冠义齿
病历与影像资料电子化
ai_s3_list: 方案判断：复杂缺牙病例的多方案权衡。
手术操作：种植体植入的位置与角度把控。
咬合调整：毫米级咬合接触的精细调改。
患者沟通：管理预期、讲清长期预后。
技工协作：把设计意图准确传达给技师。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明修复牙科的「设计与流程端」正在数字化：取模、方案、制作都被 CAD/CAM 和 AI 重构，常规修复效率大幅提升。但临床判断、手术操作和咬合调整是医师的核心壁垒，AI 越普及，复杂病例越依赖真功夫。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中位曝光是升级信号：会用数字化工具和 AI 方案的医师，接诊效率和客单价双提升。把种植和全口重建等复杂技术做精，再配上数字化流程，是修复专科医师最稳的增长路径。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 口腔医学是长周期高投入方向，但回报确定。修复专科更是「越老越值钱」，建议孩子本科阶段就确认对口腔外科和手感的兴趣；家庭要接受规培和进修期的投入。
把数字化修复和种植技术补起来，往复杂病例（全口重建、咬合重建）方向深耕。同时建立自己的患者口碑，修复科医师的复诊和转介绍率极高，口碑就是收入。
非口腔科班很难直接转修复医师，需要从口腔医学路径重新走。有牙科助手或技工背景的可以边工作边考学；面试与求职时，突出你的精细操作和患者沟通案例。
修复专科医师稀缺，建议用「设备投入 + 病例支持 + 进修通道」吸引人才。数字化设备能显著提升修复效率，但别省技工协作和培训投入，质量口碑才是诊所的护城河。

ai_s7_trends: 数字化取模与 CAD/CAM 普及，修复流程效率大幅提升。
种植修复与全口重建需求增长，复杂病例医师价值凸显。
「数字化 + 复杂病例」复合能力成为修复专科的核心竞争力。

body: 修复牙科医师是口腔医学修复专科医师，负责诊断与治疗缺牙、牙体缺损与咬合功能障碍，通过种植体、牙冠、固定桥、活动义齿与全口重建等方案恢复患者的咀嚼功能与面部美。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can perform an initial remote diagnosis, but technicians still decide which circuit board truly needs replacement, how to remove and install it safely in an equipment room, and how to assess conditions on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 156,900 telecommunications repair workers were employed in 2024, projected to decrease to 150,400 by 2034, a net loss of about 6,500 jobs, with about 13,200 openings annually. ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace installation and repair technicians, but it will reduce initial diagnostic roles. Remote diagnostics and parts databases accelerate initial troubleshooting, shifting technicians from finding faults toward on-site removal and installation, complex diagnosis, preventive maintenance, and knowledge capture. People who only replace standard parts will face pressure, while those with diagnostic judgment and hands-on ability will become more valuable.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: At 8/10, relatively high AI exposure applies to this hardware-support occupation. Systems accelerate initial diagnosis, but people still perform hands-on work and make diagnostic judgments.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces standard-part replacement tasks, not hardware-support roles. People with diagnostic judgment and hands-on ability will become scarcer as productivity rises. Technicians who only replace standard parts are most vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with electronics and certifications and gain extensive hands-on practice. Pure part replacement is shrinking in the AI era, so develop diagnostic judgment early.
Advance from replacing parts to diagnosing problems and managing preventive maintenance. Learn remote diagnostics and aim to take responsibility for a service area.
Highlight certifications and equipment repaired, specifying the standards and systems you have supported. Clients value reliability and speed.
Do not hire based only on physical strength. Assess diagnostic thinking. Key technicians who handle complex faults merit higher allowances.
